name: Protocol Conformance Fixtures
description: A shared test fixture set that any implementation can run to prove it conforms to the protocol spine.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture set covers all protocol spine message types
Each fixture includes valid and intentionally invalid payloads
Fixtures are language-agnostic (JSON/YAML files with metadata)
Runner script produces a PASS/FAIL report per fixture
New protocol additions must include corresponding fixtures
CI enforces that all implementations pass the conformance suite
